roulette_rule_1: Every participant must pick one film — no more, no less.
roulette_rule_2: Every participant must watch the drawn film.
roulette_rule_3: The roulette has a fixed weekly day and time. The grace period is 15 minutes. Give a heads-up if you're not joining. Extra sessions are independent.
roulette_rule_4: You can't pick a film that's already on the wheel — the idea is equal odds for every film and encouraging people to go looking for picks.
roulette_rule_5_1: No sexual content. That doesn't mean no nudity (best avoided), just no gratuitous sex. We recommend tools like Does the Dog Die to check beforehand.
roulette_rule_5_2: There are no rules about the quality of the films.
roulette_rule_5_3: Picking media that isn't film-shaped (a short film, a run of short stories, a 3/4-episode anime) must be judged by that roulette's participants.
roulette_rule_5_4: Very long films (2h+) must also be reviewed beforehand.
roulette_goodwill_1: Pick films you haven't watched yet — and that most people probably haven't either.
roulette_goodwill_3: Download the film ahead of time, check the subtitles, upload it to telegram or whatever.
roulette_goodwill_4: Don't worry about what people will think of the film. It's impossible to be worse than Eduardo.
roulette_spin_caption: syncs fullscreen on every screen · winner → history
